5 Best APKs for Firestick/Android TV Box in 2026 (Free Movies)

September 18, 2026 / Streaming Apps & Sites

This post will provide you with a continually updated list of the Best APKs for watching Movies, TV shows, live channels, and sports in 2026.

APK stands for Android Application Package. You can think of this as an installation file for Android-based systems.

Many prefer to install these on media devices such as Amazon Firesticks and Android/Google TV boxes. This is because these devices have sideloading capabilities, unlike other popular choices such as Roku.

Sideloading is often referred to as “jailbreaking” which is what allows us to install these APK files!

The choices below provide high-definition content that play without buffering and this is especially true when integrated with a premium resolving source such as TorBox or Premiumize.

The following rankings are determined by Troy and valuable input from TROYPOINT Insiders who use these apps on a daily basis.

How We Test These APKs

Every app on this page gets installed on real hardware before it earns a spot. We run each APK on an Android-powered device, then check the things that actually break.

Here is what we look at on every app:

  • Does it install and open? Plenty of apps making the rounds right now will not even launch on current Fire OS.
  • Is Amazon blocking it? Several popular names are blocked on Fire TV right now, and plenty of guides still recommend them.
  • Do the links play? We load actual titles and watch them, both on free sources and with a debrid service connected.
  • Does debrid integration work? An app can claim TorBox, Real-Debrid, or Premiumize support and still fail to pass links through.
  • How heavy are the ads? Marketing copy says ad-free far more often than the app is.
  • Is the file clean? We run the APK through VirusTotal before recommending it.

We re-check this list monthly and pull apps once they stop working, which is why entries come off this page instead of sitting here with a refreshed date on top.

The TROYPOINT Insider community is the other half of this. Insiders run these apps daily across a wide range of devices and report problems in the forum, often before we catch them ourselves. That feedback shapes the rankings below and it is not something a roundup written from a desk can replicate.

2. Nuvio

Nuvio is the latest media hub to hit the cord-cutting scene and it’s already turning heads. After testing we consider it the best new APK to arrive in quite some time.

What sets this app apart from every other choice on our list is the user profile system, which lets you create separate profiles with their own add-ons, plugins, and watch history under one free account.

The app accepts both Stremio add-ons and its own Plugin system that scrapes provider repositories for direct HD links. Your free dashboard on Nuvio’s website lets you manage everything from a browser and sync it to your Fire TV, Android TV box, or phone instantly.

Nuvio is still in Beta but performance is already impressive with fast navigation and quick source loading. The app is free, ad-free, and available on Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV, Android mobile devices, and iOS.

Cord cutters chase the next free movie APK every few weeks. The links break, the app stops opening, or Amazon blocks it on Fire TV, and then the cycle starts again.

Even the app stores that hosted them aren’t safe. APKTime shut down in June 2026 after a decade, with its founders pointing users to TROYPOINT.

Other Popular APKs Among Cord Cutters

Below are some of the other free APKs you’ll see floating around the cord-cutting community. Most fall into the “crap app” category we just covered, but we’re including them so you know what they are when you see them recommended elsewhere.

BeeTV

BeeTV has been one of the most cloned apps in the cord-cutting space. The version most people install today is a fork of a fork, with no clear developer behind it and no real roadmap.

Ads are heavy, malware reports pop up regularly, and Amazon is currently blocking it on Fire TV. Some Insiders still use it on Android boxes paired with a debrid service, but for most people Stremio is the smarter swap.

Unlike other options on our list of best APKs, Streamflix offers different provider sources to choose from so you don’t have to locate these and can simply select one of the choices provided.

One of the biggest features available is the auto play capabilities that are built right in so you won’t have to guess when choosing a link and your playback will begin immediately. This one is definitely worth giving a shot!

CloudStream

CloudStream is an open-source app that works like Kodi or Stremio, using repositories and extensions that scrape the web for movies, shows, anime, live TV, and torrents. It’s completely free, supports Real-Debrid, TorBox, and Premiumize for better links, and runs on Fire TV, Google TV, Android boxes, and phones.

Unlike most of the throwaway apps in this section, CloudStream stays in active development and its official APK scanned clean on VirusTotal. Because many sources pull from torrents, a VPN is strongly recommended here.

Stremize

There’s no free tier here. Stremize runs on a premium subscription after a 7-day trial (no card required), with Solo, Home, and Zone plans depending on how many devices you need.

Best APKs FAQ

What are the best apps to download on a jailbroken Firestick?

Start with Stremio, Nuvio, and Kodi. Stremio and Nuvio work as soon as you add your add-ons, while Kodi needs third-party addons or a build before it streams anything. You will also want the Downloader app from the Amazon App Store, which is the easiest way to sideload the rest.

Which Firesticks allow 3rd party apps?

The Fire TV Stick Lite, 4K, 4K Plus, 4K Max, and every Fire TV Cube run Fire OS, which is built on Android, so they install APK files through the Downloader app. The exceptions are the Fire TV Stick 4K Select and the 2nd generation Fire TV Stick HD, which run Amazon’s Vega OS and cannot sideload at all, so avoid those two if you plan to install third-party apps.

Are Streaming APKs Legal?

There is no way for us to determine whether or not 3rd party APKs carry the proper licensing. We recommend only accessing media not protected by copyright such as those that fall under Public Domain status. The end-user is responsible for all content accessed through unverified apps. For verified options, see our list of legal streaming apps.

What replaced BeeTV on Firestick?

Nothing officially replaced BeeTV. Stremio and Nuvio are where most of our Insiders went, and both install on Firestick for free. If you liked BeeTV because it found links for you without much setup, Nuvio will feel closest, since its Plugin system pulls in sources automatically once you add them from your dashboard.

What’s the best live TV APK?

For live channels, a paid live TV service paired with a player app is far more dependable than any free APK. The free apps on this page that advertise live TV, including Stremize and Arvio, have weak live sections even when their movie and show side works well. Free live channels tend to go down without warning because the sources behind them disappear.

Are APK files safe to install?

An APK file is only as safe as the place you downloaded it from. The format itself is just an installer, the same one Google Play uses, so the file type tells you nothing about the contents. The risk comes from grabbing a modified build off a random site. We run the apps on this page through VirusTotal before recommending them, though a scan is one signal rather than a guarantee, and a VPN is still worth running.

Final Notes from Troy

Most new cord-cutters start with Kodi, but most eventually settle into Stremio, Nuvio, or one of the other top picks above. The setup is easier, the interfaces are cleaner, and you avoid the constant cycle of broken APKs and Amazon blocks.

Pick one or two from the top five, pair it with a debrid service, connect to a VPN, and you’re set. You can install as many as you want, but once you find an app that clicks you probably won’t need the rest.
